summary:
Held 0 of today's 10 biggest UK/EU movers.

• 6 upside misses — AKZA.AS +5%, ANTO.L +5%, AAF.L +4%, AAL.L +4%, AC.PA +3%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 4 downside moves (AD.AS -2%, BP.L -2%, KER.PA -2%, AZN.L -2%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: AKZA.AS (+4.52%) — No clear Nov 3 headline found. Likely a rebound or re-rating around the pending Axalta merger (early-2027 close) and the recent Q3 / SE Asia Deco sale news, plus a possible sector move. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe: AKZA.AS is a mid/large-cap Dutch coatings name that no strategy lists. The move also looks deal- and news-driven with no identifiable gap catalyst, so a momentum or news-reactive filter would not have flagged it pre-open.
